issues.description: Static delivery method name mismatch: the problem statement (UML and textual description) and the template Main expect a static method named acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), but the reference implementation defines a static method named receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) in SealSaloon. Because the method name differs, calls or tests that invoke acceptSupplyDelivery will not find the expected method in the solution implementation and will fail (compilation or test failures), and students will be confused which name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the delivery method name consistent with the problem statement and template. Rename the solution method receiveDelivery(...) to acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity), preserving it as static and keeping the same parameters and behavior. Alternatively, add a static acceptSupplyDelivery(...) wrapper in SealSaloon that delegates to receiveDelivery(...). Update any callers or documentation to use the single agreed name.
